subject: Logic
title: Tu Quoque
description: A quick win: understand Tu Quoque.

hook.text: "You shouldn't smoke." "But you smoke too!" Does that make smoking healthy?

buildup.text: Tu quoque—Latin for "you too"—deflects criticism by pointing out the critic's hypocrisy.

discovery.text: A doctor who smokes can still give good advice about quitting. Hypocrisy doesn't erase facts.

twist.text: It works because we feel that hypocrites lack moral standing. But the argument stands alone.

climax.text: Judge the argument, not the arguer. If the logic is solid, the messenger is irrelevant.

punchline.text: "You do it too" is a dodge, not a defense.
